ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixel values across the ventral surface with high-intensity (white) pixel clusters localized to linear and circular surface disruptions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous low-intensity dark field mapping across approximately 90% of the visible surface. High-contrast white geometric clusters are mapped as thin linear streaks across the right lobe and scattered circular rosettes on both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central notch with a sharp interior pixel vertex and significant vertical depth relative to the fluke lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern extracted along the entire trailing edge boundary, featuring distinct pixel-level peaks and valleys particularly dense on the distal regions.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex trailing edge curvature tapering into slightly elevated, irregular distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular, high-contrast white ring-shaped pixel clusters (5-10 pixel diameter) distributed across the central and outer lobes, consistent with barnacle scar sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of distinct, unaligned white linear pixel tracks (rake marks) appearing as high-contrast disruptions against the dark background, most concentrated on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive rake marks (linear abrasions) and circular attachment scars visible across both lobes; jagged irregularities on the distal tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinct circular 'o-ring' shaped scar located on the mid-left lobe.
